content:
Sorry for the long wait. Apple TV subscribers can stream the first episode of the new season of "Slow Horses" right now, just hours after the platform announced the series had been renewed for two more seasons. Watch the new season trailer right now.

Season 6 of "Slow Horses" is now on Apple TV.

Apple TV has just released the first episode of Season 6 of "Slow Horses," with new episodes dropping every Wednesday through October 21.

The series returns just a day after Saul Metzstein won Best Direction in a Drama Series for the previous season finale "Scars," and just hours after Apple TV announced a two-season renewal.

"Slow Horses" premiered to rave reviews in early 2022 and has aired at a faster pace than most series, releasing more than one season per year on average.

Expectations for the new season are high, with the review site Awards Buzz calling it the show's best season yet.
